name: movemate
description: A simple web app where neighbors post move-in / move-out requests, everyone in the neighborhood gets alerted (live feed), and people tap to volunteer. Static frontend (like Decode) + Supabase backend (auth, Postgres, realtime). Free to run.

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js styles.css manifest.json sw.js privacy.html www/ && cp -r icons www/ && echo www built
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
